avoid_months.reason: Monsoon: the river can rise so high that the Ganga Aarti shifts to a higher platform

stops.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
stops.note: Evening Ganga Aarti lasts about 45 minutes. Watching from the public steps is free. Aarti time follows sunset and sources disagree: roughly 5:45-6:45 PM in winter and 6:45-7:15 PM in summer. Check locally on the day. Arrive early for a good spot.

days.title: Kashi Vishwanath and the old city

stops.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
stops.note: Official site: general darshan 4 AM to 11 AM, a break for Bhog Aarti, then noon to 7 PM, with the evening Aarti from 7 to 8:30 PM. Mangla Aarti starts between 3 and 4 AM. Entry for children under 12 is free. Ticket must be shown at the entry for aarti slots. Entry is subject to temple administration approval.

stops.name: Sarnath (Dhamek Stupa and Archaeological Museum)
stops.note: Museum (ASI site): 9 AM to 5 PM, closed every Friday. The Dhamek Stupa and archaeological area stay open on Fridays, roughly 6 AM to 6 PM.

booking_notes.text: Sugam Darshan and aarti slots are booked only on the temple's official site. Prices vary between third-party sites, so none is stated here.
